name: Scholarships
description: Looking for the suitable university and scholarship programs could be a challenging task for students wishing to study abroad. Several European countries and Turkey offer various government- and/or university-funded scholarship programs for international applicants. Academically talented and high-achieving students can benefit from scholarship awards that cover tuition fees fully or partially in addition to financial aid or stipend. Offers for funded scholarships differ depending on the country, type of institution and degree program that you are going to apply. ICES Turkey does not offer consultancy services; however, we can provide guidance to international students in their home country.
